project: Roofing SMS receptionist — hardening (from 2026-07-23 multi-agent audit)
goal: Roofing AI receptionist works for every tenant (old/new/suspended), every caller (known, unknown, opted-out, shared numbers), and never loses a lead or leaks another tenant's data.

stories.title: Non-active tenant numbers do not transact
stories.detail: tenants.status is selected and logged but never gated. A suspended/onboarding tenant's provisioned number must not run the AI pipeline, quote, or create customer rows. Silent ack (empty TwiML), logged.

stories.title: Tradie is notified when a roofing quote is sent or an inspection is booked
stories.detail: Roofing path never notifies owner_mobile — leads land in the DB silently. Mirror notifyPaintingTradie: notify on send_saved (quote delivered) and on booking confirmed. Injected dispatch, never throws.

stories.title: Global STOP opt-out honoured on every conversation type
stories.detail: STOP/UNSUBSCRIBE currently only honoured inside roofing/painting receptionists, per-conversation. A standard Twilio opt-out keyword as the whole message must close the conversation and suppress the AI reply on any thread. (Carrier-side send suppression is Twilio 21610.)

stories.title: Customer memory is tenant-scoped
stories.detail: customers rows are globally unique by phone; memory (name/suburb/address/email/total_quotes) currently leaks across tenants into prompts and seeded slots. Gate all memory use on customer.tenant_id matching the resolved tenant (legacy null tenant_id stays allowed).

stories.title: tradeScopeDirective derives from the full trades[] list
stories.detail: Directive only knows electrical/plumbing: tenants with roofing enabled never advertise it ('we do electrical and plumbing' straight after a roofing quote), tenants without roofing get no decline rule. Advertise enabled extras; explicitly decline disabled ones (no quote, no $99 inspection).

stories.title: Disabling roofing mid-thread closes stale roofing_state
stories.detail: Turning roofing off with a conversation parked at confirm_roof/await_booking orphans it — the general dialog inherits a warm roofing thread. When the gate is off and roofing_state is active, close it.

stories.title: tenant/me selects customers.phone_number, not nonexistent phone
stories.detail: app/api/tenant/me/route.ts:436 selects 'id, phone, email' — customers has phone_number. PostgREST errors and the dashboard loses customer contact info.

stories.title: WhatsApp fallback never replies from a stranger's number on tenant flows
stories.detail: dispatchQuoteMessage falls back to WhatsApp from the global TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM even when the SMS was meant to come from the tenant's own number. Skip the WhatsApp fallback when a custom tenant from was requested; keep it for shared/dev-number flows.

stories.title: No-tenant roofing SMS tier presentation matches the quote page
stories.detail: Audit: null-tenant roofing SMS sends Good/Better/Best while the linked page/PDF render single-tier. Align the SMS default with the page's default.

out_of_scope: Per-speaker identity on shared numbers (needs product design — receptionist would have to ask names)
customers (phone, tenant) composite-key migration — Phase 2 schema work; US-004 is the app-layer mitigation
Keyword-free engagement for roofing-only tenants (by design: any inbound to a roofing-only tradie is presumed a lead)
pricing_book seeding when a trade is enabled (product decision on defaults vs forced setup)
